<!-- # Accuracy -->

```{r fig_tscore, echo=FALSE, fig.height=4, fig.width=4, fig.cap="Accuracy of Topic Predictions vs. Prompt. Accuracy = $P[\\hat{Y}=Y^*] = \\frac{1}{10k} \\sum_{i=1}^{10k} 1\\{\\hat{Y}_i=Y_i^*\\}$"}
levels.model = c("gpt-3.5-turbo-0125", "gpt-4o")
labels.model = c("GPT-3.5", "GPT-4o")

bills_prompts_responses <- read.csv(file.path(repo_dir, "02_llm/bills_prompts_responses_10000.csv")) %>%
  rename(c(prompt=PromptingStrategyID, model=Model, Yhuman=Major, Yllm=MajorLLM)) %>%
  mutate(model = factor(model, levels=levels.model, labels=labels.model)) %>%
  select(c(prompt, model, Yhuman, Yllm)) %>%
  group_by(model, prompt) %>%
  summarise(accuracy = mean(Yhuman==Yllm), .groups="drop")

model.colors <- c("GPT-3.5"="#97BD59", "GPT-4o"="#277BB6")
model.shapes <- c("GPT-3.5"=16, "GPT-4o"=17)

p <- ggplot(bills_prompts_responses, aes(x=as.factor(prompt), y=accuracy, fill=model)) +
  geom_col(position=position_dodge()) +
  scale_fill_manual(name="Model", values=model.colors) +
  # labs(title="Accuracy of Topic Predictions vs. Prompt",
  #      subtitle=TeX("($Accuracy = P[\\hat{Y}=Y^*] = \\frac{1}{10^4} \\sum_{i=1}^{10^4} 1\\{\\hat{Y}_i=Y_i^*\\}$)")) +
  xlab("Prompt Index") +
  ylab("Accuracy") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(0,1, by=0.25), minor_breaks=seq(0,1, by=0.05), limits=c(0,1)) +
  my_theme

p
# ggsave(plot=p, file=file.path(figures_dir, "coef_lhs.png"), height=5, width=5)
```

# Proxy on the LHS

<!-- ## Coefficients -->


```{r, echo=FALSE, fig.height=5.4, fig.width=8, fig.cap="Ordered $\\hat{\\beta}$ vs. Prompt. Proxy on the LHS: $Y = \\beta_{0} + \\beta_{1} V$"}
csv_path <- file.path(repo_dir, "04_simulation/lhs/bayesian")
levels.Y = c(3, 14, 15, 19, 20)
labels.Y = c(TeX("$Y_3$"), TeX("$Y_{14}$"), TeX("$Y_{15}$"), TeX("$Y_{19}$"), TeX("$Y_{20}$"))

levels.V = c("Democrat", "Senate", "DW1")
labels.V = c(TeX("$Y = \\beta_{0} + \\beta_{1} Democrat$"), TeX("$Y = \\beta_{0} + \\beta_{1} Senate$"), TeX("$Y = \\beta_{0} + \\beta_{1} DW1$")) 

levels.coef = c("(Intercept)", "V")
labels.coef = c(TeX("$\\beta_{0}$"), TeX("$\\beta_{1}$"))

levels.model = c("gpt-3.5", "gpt-4o")
labels.model = c("GPT-3.5", "GPT-4o")

df.10k_llm <- read.csv(file.path(csv_path, "10k_llm_lhs.csv")) %>%
  select(!c(se, se.ref)) %>%
  filter(coef_name!="(Intercept)") %>%
  mutate(Y = factor(Y, levels=levels.Y, labels=labels.Y),
         V = factor(V, levels=levels.V, labels=labels.V),
         coef_name = factor(coef_name, levels=levels.coef, labels=labels.coef),
         model = factor(model, levels=levels.model, labels=labels.model),
         ) %>%
  group_by(V, Y, model, coef_name) %>%
  arrange(V, Y, model, coef_name, coef) %>%
  mutate(prompt_coef.ordered = row_number()) %>%
  group_by(V, Y, model, coef_name) %>%
  arrange(V, Y, model, coef_name, t) %>%
  mutate(prompt_t.ordered = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup()

# Check that we don't have NA's in any of t_scores
if(any(!complete.cases(df.10k_llm)))
  stop("Missing t-scores")

# yellow "#FFD166"

line_shapes <- c("star"="solid")
line_labels <- c("star"=TeX("$\\beta^*$"))

model.labels <-c("GPT-3.5"=TeX("$\\hat{\\beta}_{GPT-3.5}$"), "GPT-4o"=TeX("$\\hat{\\beta}_{GPT-4o}$"))

subtitle <- TeX("Proxy on the LHS: $Y = \\beta_{0} + \\beta_{1} V$")

p <- df.10k_llm %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=as.factor(prompt_coef.ordered), color=model, shape=model)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept=0, color="#262626", linewidth=0.2) +
  
  # geom_ribbon(aes(ymin=lci.ref, ymax=uci.ref), alpha=0.2, fill="#C74B08", linetype="dashed", linewidth=0.0) +
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept=lci.ref), color="#F85427", linetype="dashed", linewidth=0.3) +
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept=uci.ref), color="#F85427", linetype="dashed", linewidth=0.3) +
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept=coef.ref, linetype="star"), color="#F85427", linewidth=0.5) +
  
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=lci, ymax=uci), position=position_dodge(width=0.5), width = 0.5, linewidth=0.3) +
  geom_point(aes(y=coef), size=1.25, alpha=0.7, position=position_dodge(width=0.5)) +
  
  scale_linetype_manual(name="", values=line_shapes, labels=line_labels) +
  scale_color_manual(name="", values=model.colors, labels=model.labels) +
  scale_shape_manual(name="", values=model.shapes, labels=model.labels) +
  
  # labs(title=TeX("Ordered $\\hat{\\beta}$ vs. Prompt"),
  #      subtitle=subtitle) +
  xlab("Prompt Index") +
  ylab("Coefficients") +
  
  facet_grid(V + coef_name ~ Y, labeller=label_parsed) +
  
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(-1,1, by=0.025)) +
  my_theme +
  theme(panel.grid.minor.y=element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.y=element_line(linewidth=0.2))
p

# ggsave(plot=p, file=file.path(figures_dir, "coef_lhs.png"), height=6, width=8)
```

        panel.grid.major.y=element_line(linewidth=0.2))

<!-- ## Empirical PDFs of the Bias -->

```{r, echo=FALSE}
csv_path <- file.path(repo_dir, "04_simulation/lhs/bayesian")
results <- read.csv(file.path(csv_path, "simulations_averaged_lhs.csv")) %>%
  filter(coef_name!="(Intercept)") %>% # Plot only beta_1
   mutate(
     Y = factor(Y, levels=levels.Y, labels=labels.Y),
     V = factor(V, levels=levels.V, labels=labels.V),
     model = factor(model, levels=levels.model, labels=labels.model),
     coef_name = factor(coef_name, levels=levels.coef, labels=labels.coef),
     regression = factor(regression, levels=c("5k_Yllm_V", "train_Yhuman_V", "test_Ytilde_V"))) 

line_colors <- c("5k_Yllm_V"      = "#F85427", 
                 "train_Yhuman_V" = "#277BB6", 
                 "test_Ytilde_V"  = "#97BD59")

line_labels <- c("5k_Yllm_V"      = TeX("Bias($\\hat{\\beta}_1, \\beta_1^*$)"), 
                 "train_Yhuman_V" = TeX("Bias($\\beta_1^{t}, \\beta_1^*$)"), 
                 "test_Ytilde_V"  = TeX("Bias($\\tilde{\\beta}_1, \\beta_1^*$)"))

bias.data <- results %>% 
  filter(train_proportion!=0.25) %>%
  mutate(train_proportion = factor(
    train_proportion, 
    levels=c(0.05, 
             0.1, 
             # 0.25, 
             0.5), 
    labels=c("Training sample proportion = 5%", 
             "Training sample proportion = 10%", 
             # "Training sample proportion = 25%", 
             "Training sample proportion = 50%")))

n_bins = 20
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, fig.height=3, fig.width=8, fig.cap="Bias Density Plots by Proportion of Training Samples. Proxy on the LHS: $Y = \\beta_{0} + \\beta_{1} V$"}
bias1 <- bias.data %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=bias_mean, group=regression, fill=regression)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept=0, color="#262626", linewidth=0.2) +
  facet_grid(. ~ train_proportion) +
  geom_histogram(
    aes(y=(..count..)/tapply(..count..,..PANEL..,sum)[..PANEL..] * nlevels(bias.data$regression)), 
        bins=n_bins, position=position_dodge()) +
  # labs(title=TeX(r"(Bias Density Plots by Proportion of Training Samples)"),
  #      subtitle=subtitle) +
  xlab("Bias") +
  ylab("Probability Densities") +
  scale_fill_manual(name="", values=line_colors, labels=line_labels) +
  scale_x_symmetric(mid=0, breaks=seq(-10,10, by=0.01))+
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(0,1, by=0.25), minor_breaks=seq(0,1, by=0.05), limits=c(0,1)) +
  my_theme
bias1
```


<!-- $$\frac{\mathbb{E}[\hat{\beta}] - \beta^\star}{\sqrt{\text{Var}[\hat{\beta}]}}$$ -->
<!-- $$\mathbb{E}[\hat{\beta}] \approx \frac{1}{N} \sum_{i=1}^N \hat{\beta}^{(i)} \triangleq \bar{\hat{\beta}}$$ -->
<!-- $$\text{Var}[\hat{\beta}] \approx \frac{1}{N-1} \sum_{i=1}^N \left(\hat{\beta}^{(i)}-\bar{\hat{\beta}}\right)^2$$ -->

```{r, echo=FALSE, fig.height=3, fig.width=8, fig.cap="Standarized Bias Density Plots by Proportion of Training Samples. Proxy on the LHS: $Y = \\beta_{0} + \\beta_{1} V$"}
bias1_standarized <- bias.data %>%
  group_by(train_proportion) %>%
  mutate(standarized_bias = bias_mean/sd(bias_mean)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=standarized_bias, group=regression, fill=regression)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept=0, color="#262626", linewidth=0.2) +
  facet_grid(. ~ train_proportion) +
  geom_histogram(
    aes(y=(..count..)/tapply(..count..,..PANEL..,sum)[..PANEL..] * nlevels(bias.data$regression)), 
    bins=n_bins, position=position_dodge()) +
  # labs(title=TeX(r"(Standarized Bias Density Plots by Proportion of Training Samples)"),
  #      subtitle=subtitle) +
  xlab("Standarized Bias") +
  ylab("Probability Densities") +
  scale_fill_manual(name="", values=line_colors, labels=line_labels) +
  scale_x_symmetric(mid=0, breaks=seq(-10,10, by=1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(0,1, by=0.25), minor_breaks=seq(0,1, by=0.05), limits=c(0,1)) +
  my_theme
bias1_standarized
```

```{r echo=FALSE, fig.height=3*1.5, fig.width=8, fig.cap="Standarized Bias Density by Model and Proportion of Training Samples. Proxy on the LHS: $Y = \\beta_{0} + \\beta_{1} V$"}

```{r, echo=FALSE, fig.height=3, fig.width=8, fig.cap="MSE Empirical CDF by Proportion of Training Samples. Proxy on the LHS: $Y = \\beta_{0} + \\beta_{1} V$"}
mse.data <- results %>% 
  filter(
    regression!="5k_Yllm_V",
    train_proportion!=0.25
    ) %>%
  mutate(train_proportion = factor(
    train_proportion, 
    levels=c(0.05, 
             0.1, 
             # 0.25, 
             0.5), 
    labels=c("Training sample proportion = 5%", 
             "Training sample proportion = 10%", 
             # "Training sample proportion = 25%", 
             "Training sample proportion = 50%"))
    )

line_colors <- c("train_Yhuman_V" = "#277BB6", 
                 "test_Ytilde_V"  = "#97BD59")
line_types <- c("train_Yhuman_V" = "dashed", 
                 "test_Ytilde_V"  = "solid")
line_labels <- c("train_Yhuman_V"=TeX(r"(MSE($\beta_1^{t}, \beta_1^*$))"), # TODO: change labels
                 "test_Ytilde_V"=TeX(r"(MSE($\tilde{\beta}_1, \beta_1^*$))"))

mse1 <- mse.data %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=mse_mean, color=regression, linetype=regression)) +
  stat_ecdf(linewidth=0.5) +
  # labs(title=TeX(r"(MSE Empirical CDF by Proportion of Training Samples)"),
  #      subtitle=subtitle) +
  facet_grid(. ~ train_proportion) +
  xlab("MSE") +
  ylab("Empirical CDF") + 
  scale_x_continuous(minor_breaks = seq(0,0.004,0.0001)) +
  scale_color_manual(name="", values=line_colors, labels=line_labels) +
  scale_linetype_manual(name="", values=line_types, labels=line_labels) +
  my_theme + theme(
    panel.grid.major.x=element_line(linewidth=0.3),
    panel.grid.minor.x=element_line(linewidth=0.1))
mse1
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, fig.height=3*1.5, fig.width=8, fig.cap="MSE Empirical CDF by Model and Proportion of Training Samples. Proxy on the LHS: $Y = \\beta_{0} + \\beta_{1} V$"}

```{r echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
p.data <- results %>%
  # filter(regression!="5k_Yllm_V", train_proportion!=0.25) %>%
  mutate(
    train_proportion = factor(
      train_proportion,
      levels=c(0.05, 0.1, 0.25, 0.50),
      labels=c("5\\%", "10\\%", "25\\%", "50\\%")))

alpha = 0.10
probs = c(alpha/2, 1-alpha/2)

df1 <- p.data %>% 
  mutate(statistic=bias_mean) %>%
  group_by(train_proportion, regression) %>% 
  summarise(
    "Mean" = mean(statistic), 
    "SD" = sd(statistic),
    "Median" = median(statistic),
    "5\\%" = quantile(statistic, probs[1]), 
    "95\\%" = quantile(statistic, probs[2]),
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(regression = factor(
      regression, 
      levels=c("5k_Yllm_V", "train_Yhuman_V", "test_Ytilde_V"), 
      labels=c("Bias($\\hat{\\beta}_1, \\beta_1^*$)", "Bias($\\beta^t_1, \\beta_1^*$)", "Bias($\\tilde{\\beta}_1, \\beta_1^*$)")
      )) %>%
  rename(c("Train Prop"=train_proportion, "Statistic"=regression))
  

stripe = as.vector(t(cbind((6*(0:30)+1), (6*(0:30)+2), (6*(0:30)+3))))

kbl(df1, align="rlrrrrr", 
    caption="Bias Summary Statistics by Proportion of Training Samples", 
    digits=6, booktabs=T, linesep = "", escape=F) %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = "striped", stripe_index = stripe)
```

# Proxy on the RHS

<!-- ## Coefficients -->

```{r, echo=FALSE, fig.height=11, fig.width=8, fig.cap="Ordered $\\hat{\\beta}$ vs. Prompt. Proxy on the RHS: $V = Y^\\top \\beta = Y_3 \\beta_3 + Y_{14} \\beta_{14} + Y_{15} \\beta_{15} + Y_{19}  \\beta_{19}+ Y_{20} \\beta_{20} + Y_{Other} \\beta_{Other}$"}
csv_path <- file.path(repo_dir, "04_simulation/rhs/bayesian")
levels.coef = c("Y3", "Y14", "Y15", "Y19", "Y20", "YOther")
labels.coef = c(TeX("$\\beta_3$"), TeX("$\\beta_{14}$"), TeX("$\\beta_{15}$"), TeX("$\\beta_{19}$"), TeX("$\\beta_{20}$"), TeX("$\\beta_{Other}$"))

levels.V = c("Democrat", "Senate", "DW1")
labels.V = c(TeX("$Democrat=Y^T\\beta$"), TeX("$Senate=Y^T\\beta$"), TeX("$DW1=Y^T\\beta$"))

levels.model = c("gpt-3.5", "gpt-4o")
labels.model = c("GPT-3.5", "GPT-4o")

model.colors <- c("GPT-3.5"="#97BD59", "GPT-4o"="#277BB6")
model.shapes <- c("GPT-3.5"=16, "GPT-4o"=17)
model.labels <-c("GPT-3.5"=TeX("$\\hat{\\beta}_{GPT-3.5}$"), "GPT-4o"=TeX("$\\hat{\\beta}_{GPT-4o}$"))

df.10k_llm <- read.csv(file.path(csv_path, "10k_llm_rhs.csv")) %>%
  select(!c(se, se.ref)) %>%
  # filter(coef_name!="YOther") %>%
  mutate(V = factor(V, levels=levels.V, labels=labels.V),
         coef_name = factor(coef_name, levels=levels.coef, labels=labels.coef),
         model = factor(model, levels=levels.model, labels=labels.model),
         ) %>%
  group_by(V, model, coef_name) %>%
  arrange(V, model, coef_name, coef) %>%
  mutate(prompt_coef.ordered = row_number()) %>%
  group_by(V, model, coef_name) %>%
  arrange(V, model, coef_name, t) %>%
  mutate(prompt_t.ordered = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup()

# Check that we don't have NA's in any of t_scores
if(any(!complete.cases(df.10k_llm)))
  stop("Missing t-scores")

line_shapes <- c("star"="solid")
line_labels <- c("star"=TeX("$\\beta^*$"))

subtitle <- TeX(r"(Proxy on the RHS: $V = Y^T \beta = Y_3 \beta_3 + Y_{14} \beta_{14} + Y_{15} \beta_{15} + Y_{19}  \beta_{19}+ Y_{20} \beta_{20} + Y_{Other} \beta_{Other}$)")

p <- df.10k_llm %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=as.factor(prompt_coef.ordered), color=model, shape=model)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept=0, color="#262626", linewidth=0.2) +
  
  # geom_ribbon(aes(ymin=lci.ref, ymax=uci.ref), alpha=0.2, fill="#C74B08", linetype="dashed", linewidth=0.0) +
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept=lci.ref), color="#F85427", linetype="dashed", linewidth=0.3) +
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept=uci.ref), color="#F85427", linetype="dashed", linewidth=0.3) +
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept=coef.ref, linetype="star"), color="#F85427", linewidth=0.5) +
  
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=lci, ymax=uci), position=position_dodge(width=0.5), width = 0.5, linewidth=0.3) +
  geom_point(aes(y=coef), size=1.25, alpha=0.7, position=position_dodge(width=0.5)) +
  
  scale_linetype_manual(name="", values=line_shapes, labels=line_labels) +
  scale_color_manual(name="", values=model.colors, labels=model.labels) +
  scale_shape_manual(name="", values=model.shapes, labels=model.labels) +
  
  # labs(title=TeX("Ordered $\\hat{\\beta}$ vs. Prompt"),
  #      subtitle=subtitle) +
  xlab("Prompt Index") +
  ylab("Coefficients") +
  
  facet_grid(coef_name ~ V, labeller=label_parsed, scale="free_y") +
  
  # scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(-1,1, by=0.025)) +
  my_theme +
  theme(panel.grid.minor.y=element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.y=element_line(linewidth=0.2))
p
```

              )
            )
          ),
      if_else(regression=="train_V_Yhuman",

                  if_else(coef_name=="beta[20]",
                    "Bias(${\\beta}^t_{20}, \\beta_{20}^*$)",
                    "Bias(${\\beta}^t_{Other}, \\beta_{Other}^*$)"
                    )
                  )
                )
              )
            ),
          if_else(coef_name=="beta[3]",
            "Bias($\\tilde{\\beta}_{3}, \\beta_{3}^*$)",
            if_else(coef_name=="beta[14]",
              "Bias($\\tilde{\\beta}_{14}, \\beta_{14}^*$)",
              if_else(coef_name=="beta[15]",
                "Bias($\\tilde{\\beta}_{15}, \\beta_{15}^*$)",
                if_else(coef_name=="beta[19]",
                  "Bias($\\tilde{\\beta}_{19}, \\beta_{19}^*$)",
                  if_else(coef_name=="beta[20]",
                    "Bias($\\tilde{\\beta}_{20}, \\beta_{20}^*$)",
                    "Bias($\\tilde{\\beta}_{Other}, \\beta_{Other}^*$)"
                    )
                  )
                )
              )
            )
          )
        )
    )
alpha = 0.10
probs = c(alpha/2, 1-alpha/2)
df1 <- p.data %>% 
  mutate(statistic=bias_mean) %>%
  group_by(train_proportion, coef_name, regression, statistic_label) %>% 
  summarise(
    "Mean" = mean(statistic), 
    "SD" = sd(statistic),
    "Median" = median(statistic),
    "5\\%" = quantile(statistic, probs[1]), 
    "95\\%" = quantile(statistic, probs[2]),
    .groups = "drop")  %>%
  select(!c(coef_name, regression)) %>%
  rename(c("Train Prop"=train_proportion, "Statistic"=statistic_label))

kbl(df1, longtable = TRUE, align="rlrrrrr",
    caption="Bias Summary Statistics by Proportion of Training Samples",
    digits=6, booktabs=T, linesep = "", escape=F) %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("striped", "scale_down"), stripe_index = stripe)
